## Checklist

- [ ] I added the theme under `community-themes/<id>/`.
- [ ] The folder name matches the `id` in `manifest.json`.
- [ ] The manifest, stylesheet, and preview are included.
- [ ] I have permission to share the theme and its preview under the stated license.
- [ ] I tested the theme in Yapmod and included a readable preview image.
